# Provenance

`parley.graphql` and `schemas/*.schema.json` are copied unchanged from [flyingrobots/parley](https://github.com/flyingrobots/parley) at commit `c80771c` (`schemas/`). The JSON Schemas are Parley's hand-written source of truth at that commit; the tests hold this target's output to them as JSON values (rule (A) of flyingrobots/parley#116).
